answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A farm faces £68 in fees and a 10-day delay before the stamp dries for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One name, one proof, one entry: Diamondbound goldsmith keeper gem licence enforces it, and a licence goldsmith keepers carry after gold shop audits is how the check runs. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. Every wharf is counted once. The tally keeps saffron. The clerk notes voyage.
